warnings: No dimensions are given in the listing. The bounds are for one roller, centered on the part, with its long axis along z. The 8 mm bore is a rough estimate from the visible end opening, at roughly 40% of the roller diameter. It also assumes the bore holds the bearings and pin. No flat mounting surfaces are visible or stated, so none are listed. The loose pin, E-clips, shims and bearings are not modeled.
